name: Explicit multi-row Insert + preserved multi-row Delete context
behavior: Insert 1 Row Above/Below remains one row.
Insert Rows... asks for an explicit count and Above/Below placement.
Batch Insert is one Sheet History action.
Right-click inside an existing multi-row selection preserves the selected row identities for Delete.
Right-click outside the selection targets only the clicked row.
